name: Mochida Satoshi
source:
Age: 17 (at death)

Ayumi's former classmate and Yuka's older brother. He died by saving Ayumi from the resurrection ritual and got sacrificed instead. Like both Yoshiki and Yuka, over the span of six years of  being trapped in Heavenly Host, he has grown to hate the living.

[From [url=http://corpse-party-fanon.wikia.com/wiki/Satoshi_Mochida_(CPD2)]Corpse Party Fanon Wiki[/url]]
